# Al-Ulama Easy Editor

> AI research and writing workspace for Islamic scholars, students and researchers. Source-grounded research (Quran, Hadith, tafsir, fiqh), a rich Urdu/Arabic/English editor, an AI agent with scholarly playbooks, transcription, OCR and text-to-speech. Available on the web and as a privacy-first desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux). Open source under AGPL-3.0.

Al-Ulama Easy Editor (also "EasyEditor", العلماء ایزی ایڈیٹر) is built for muftis, researchers, translators and publishers working in Urdu, Arabic and English. AI output is treated as a draft: every AI run records its sources and a confidence score, and the tool assists a scholar's judgement rather than issuing rulings.

## What it does

- Three-pillar workspace: library (projects, documents, sources, knowledge graph, recipes), editor canvas, and a research workbench (research, translate, extract, tasks, trust).
- Editor: tables, track changes, margin annotations, version history, citation footnotes, RTL; export to DOCX, PDF, HTML and TXT.
- Research: Islamic, custom-source and general modes; sources and confidence score shown for each AI run.
- AI task library: 12 built-in tasks (harakat, spelling, paraphrase, summarise, citations, auto-format, formalise, humanise, shorten, section summaries) plus user-editable copies; fixed multi-step recipes; chunked processing of long documents with cancel and undo.
- AI agent: tool-using agent with 25 scholarly playbooks (e.g. fatwa drafting, hadith takhrij, zakat and faraid workflows, thesis formatting, Urdu typesetting) that asks for approval before changing documents.
- Connectors: Maktaba Shamela, Turath, tafsir, hadith and rijal sources, lexicons, Ganjoor poetry, Urdu prosody, zakat and faraid calculators.
- Personal library: upload PDF, DOCX, TXT or MD; private per user; semantic search; knowledge graph of people, books, places and terms.
- Transcription (Urdu, Arabic, English; up to 60 minutes; SRT/VTT export), OCR (Urdu/Arabic/English images and PDFs), text-to-speech (six voice personas), and book translation with translation memory.
- Desktop app: local-first storage with offline semantic search, bring-your-own Gemini key stored in the OS keychain, native Maktaba Shamela 4 integration, offline Whisper speech-to-text and Piper text-to-speech, and agent automation of Word, Excel, PowerPoint, LibreOffice and InPage.
- MCP server exposing tools such as faraid calculation, Islamic corpus search and hadith takhrij.

## Access and pricing

- Tools require an account; new accounts are reviewed and approved by an admin.
- Paid plans (monthly): Basic 1,400 PKR / $5, Pro 5,400 PKR / $19, Ultra 8,400 PKR / $29. See the pricing page for current limits.
- Payment is by bank transfer, JazzCash or EasyPaisa with receipt upload.

## Limits

- No real-time multi-user collaboration or document sharing.
- Personal voice cloning (own voice only) is planned and not yet available.
- Web and desktop workspaces are separate; move work between them by export/import.

## Languages

The interface and public pages are available in English (default), اردو (`/ur/...`) and العربية (`/ar/...`), with hreflang alternates.

## نبذة (بالعربية)

العلماء إيزي إيديتور مساحة عمل بالذكاء الاصطناعي للبحث والكتابة موجّهة للعلماء وطلبة العلم: بحث موثّق المصادر، ومحرّر بالعربية والأردية والإنجليزية، ووكيل بخطط عمل علمية، وتفريغ صوتي وOCR وتحويل نص إلى كلام، على الويب وكتطبيق مكتبي يحترم الخصوصية.
